entries.title: Job 16:1
segments: ¶Then Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 16:2
segments: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters [are] ye all. {miserable: or, troublesome}

entries.title: Job 16:3
segments: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest? {vain...: Heb. words of wind}

entries.title: Job 16:4
segments: I also could speak as ye [do]: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.

entries.title: Job 16:5
segments: [But] I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage [your grief].

entries.title: Job 16:6
segments: ¶Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and [though] I forbear, what am I eased? {what...: Heb. what goeth from me?}

entries.title: Job 16:7
segments: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.

words.text: But now he hath made me weary

entries.title: Job 16:8
segments: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, [which] is a witness [against me]: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.

words.text: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles

entries.title: Job 16:9
segments: He teareth [me] in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

entries.title: Job 16:10
segments: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.

entries.title: Job 16:11
segments: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked. {hath...: Heb. hath shut me up}

entries.title: Job 16:12
segments: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken [me] by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.

words.text: , but he hath broken me asunder

entries.title: Job 16:13
segments: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.

entries.title: Job 16:14
segments: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.

entries.title: Job 16:15
segments: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.

entries.title: Job 16:16
segments: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids [is] the shadow of death;

entries.title: Job 16:17
segments: ¶Not for [any] injustice in mine hands: also my prayer [is] pure.

entries.title: Job 16:18
segments: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.

entries.title: Job 16:19
segments: Also now, behold, my witness [is] in heaven, and my record [is] on high. {on high: Heb. in the high places}

words.text: . {on high: Heb. in the high places}

entries.title: Job 16:20
segments: My friends scorn me: [but] mine eye poureth out [tears] unto God. {scorn me: Heb. are my scorners}

entries.title: Job 16:21
segments: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man [pleadeth] for his neighbour! {neighbour: or, friend}

entries.title: Job 16:22
segments: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way [whence] I shall not return. {a few...: Heb. years of number}
